children: Semiconductor stocks pared early gains on Thursday, boosted by AI startup Anthropic's
record-breaking stock market debut, while AMD
shares fell sharply following a new short report.
Semiconductors
were up 1.29%, after gaining about 3% in premarket trading.
Anthropic
, above the guided range, and increased the size of its offering amid demand roughly seven times the shares available. The offering raised about $81.3B, valuing the company at around $1.5T.

The listing boosted shares of companies with exposure to the AI startup, as well as semiconductor makers. But some of those gains faded during regular trading. AMD shares, which had advanced before the market opened, fell more than 10% following a new short report from Hunterbrook on its Chinese exports.
Nvidia
also gave up some of its gains, falling from an intraday high of $158 at 9.45 am, now trading at $152.85.
Micron
and Broadcom
held on to gains of about 3% each, while Intel
rose 5% after CEO Lip-Bu Tan said the company had
